## Problem

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible software gap. Link relevant
issues, PRs or feature direction in `ROADMAP.md` when useful. Public contributors
do not need Notion access; maintainers reconcile actionable status into the
owner workspace Engineering Queue.

## Required behavior

List concrete acceptance criteria, including failure and unavailable-data cases.

## Invariants

State scientific settings, artifact identities, compatibility, and safety
properties that must not change.

## Verification

Name focused tests, broader regression suites, and any real-hardware gate. Do not
substitute an experiment outcome for code acceptance.
